purpose: Comparator records for NYSC COURSE-023 and COURSE-060 Construction Site Supervisor. The governed catalogue publishes no module headings for these courses, so the records are shown without a competency matrix. Records describe documented curriculum only and do not establish equivalence, quality or labour demand.
status_note: No record has been human-verified yet. Every record must be checked against its official source by a researcher before publication.

country_group_gaps.developing_emerging: No developing/emerging-economy construction site supervisor standard or curriculum was verified on 2026-10-18. TESDA's list of promulgated training regulations includes no site-supervision qualification; India's CSDCI 'Supervisor Structure (Technical)' (NSQF 5.5 upskilling) was seen only in search results and was not inspected.
